author: skellyboi730
body:
• Morbified (now Morby)
  • Excessive infractions
  • Because this is a great community and I would love to get back into the community and I want to change, I can contribute to the server and the community and be constructive whatever it may be because I think this server is great fun and it was foolish to get myself banned because now my friends are still playing it but I cant which makes me feel left out. I am mature and stable to go on the server without getting anymore infractions. I have heard some cases of people being appealed within  4 months, so if this is possible in my case please consider, if you come to a conclusion that this is not the case please specify the time I have left, if this is so, then thankyou.Oh and Happy new year.
Kindest Regards,
Morby

replies.body:
Hello Morbified,

I'm convinced you have learn't your lesson, you seem some what remorseful and you have spent a decent amount of time away from Avicus. On that note i will appeal this infraction, please do not make me regret this decision. Welcome back.

Regards,
